Definition: a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans)
BiblicalUsage: Canaanite = see Cana "zealous"; adj; 1) descendant of inhabitant of Canaan; n; 2) descendant or inhabitant of Canaan; 3) a merchant, trader
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
